I use an 80 percent half-width of 0.13, giving 1.90 - 0.13 = 1.77 and 1.90 + 0.13 = 2.03; because the official print is rounded to one decimal, this effectively covers first-print outcomes of 1.8, 1.9, and 2.0 percent."},{"kind":"text","text":"Counter-considerations: upside risk is a September rebound in voluntary quits from better worker confidence or service-sector churn, which would land above the interval if the first print rounds materially above 2.0 percent.
